result.description: A fictional compact power supply designed for quiet mini-ITX builds, the Orchid Pulse SFX-750 delivers 750W of fully modular output with an 80 Plus Platinum efficiency rating. It includes a zero-RPM fan mode, Japanese capacitors, and a single +12V rail for stable power delivery in small-form-factor systems. Ideal for enthusiast desktops, compact workstations, and space-constrained PC cases.
